questions.question_text: Which sentence is correctly constructed?

Read the following sentences and sort them so that they conform to the Opening Body Conclusion content structure: A. They explore how media shapes cultural norms and consumer behaviour. B. Overall, media studies equip students with skills to navigate the information-saturated world intelligently. C. Media studies help students critically analyse the influence of mass communication in modern society. D. Additionally, students learn to identify bias and propaganda in media messages.

options.A: Opening: C; Main Body: A and D; Conclusion: B
options.B: Opening: A; Main Body: D and C; Conclusion: B
options.C: Opening: C; Main Body: D and B; Conclusion: A
options.D: Opening: B; Main Body: A and C; Conclusion: D
